title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon, with "fast end-to-end task completion" across coding, knowledge work, and science, in the API, Antigravity, and the Gemini app (Koray Kavukcuoglu/Google)
summary: Koray Kavukcuoglu / Google: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon, with “fast end-to-end task completion” across coding, knowledge work, and science, in the API, Antigravity, and the Gemini app — Bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
